entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md, and ai-led-session-workflow.md.
Confirmed restore-devidp is complete (change-log.md present). SSO button is wired.

Added SystemAdmin, BackofficeUser, CrossOrgMonitor to admin@acmecoffee.com in user-roles.json (API + Web). Updated security-config.json RoleSwitching.AllowedRoles. Fixed UserContextBar to filter switch menu to user own roles.

Fixed UserContextBar.razor.cs to filter switch menu to user own roles. RoleSwitching.AllowedRoles set to [SystemAdmin, BackofficeUser, CrossOrgMonitor] in security-config.json. admin@acmecoffee.com has all 3 roles in user-roles.json.

Rewrote SensitiveFieldMaskingUatCoverageTests.cs: 6 separate [Fact] methods (UAT-1 through UAT-6), real magic-link login per test, role switching via UserContextBar, in-circuit Blazor navigation, // begin STEP NNN markers, visible-label locators in step blocks.
dotnet build: 0 errors, 184 warnings (all pre-existing). dotnet test (non-Playwright): 666 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
Routed session-verification via opus ($0.9161) with full disclosure of red Playwright suite.

Playwright suite passes 6/6 twice in a row (idempotent). Total non-Playwright + Playwright tests: 666 + 6 = 672 passing. Fixes: granter-precedence in MaskExemptionsSubTab, role-switcher activator testid, popover-text for menu items, first-row click for customer.
Round 2 verification via opus ($1.0927) after Playwright suite turned green.

W2 runner backfill (uat-runner-and-triage-feedback Session 4 redo): invoked `python ai-router/uat_runner/cli.py` against this checklist + docs/component-catalog/index.json. Result: 47 W0 compile errors, ALL matched tools/uat-suppressions.json patterns (UnknownRoute on /login, /dev/email-inbox, plus the click-driven-route-cursor wildcard). Runner correctly identified all errors as suppressed-but-noted; reported 'passed with warnings'. Did NOT proceed to dotnet test because the W0 CLI does not yet expose --suppressions or --skip-step flags — the runner cannot emit a test wrapper from a partially-suppressed compile. Tracked as a follow-up in tools/uat-suppressions.json. The original Haiku Session 4 commit (53c5ca5) claimed this backfill was done and 'VERIFIED (Gemini Pro, $0.0048)' but neither claim was truthful per the post-hoc verification on 2026-04-28.
